name: zan-workflows
description: Company requirement development, TAPD and Wiki-link workflows, page review, MR review, debug token, identity, memory, and unified Hub-first project knowledge for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: TAPD task breakdown, development and delivery workflows.
interface.longDescription: Bundles requirement task breakdown with verified developers, final workload estimates and confirmation before TAPD writes; then linked branch-bound Plans, implementation, optional test submission, master delivery and local cleanup. Also includes TAPD Bug handling, Wiki workflows, GitLab MR review, debug tokens, team identity and project memory. Project knowledge queries use one entrypoint with Graphify Hub first and local knowledge fallback, retaining source and revision evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use the appropriate Zan workflow skill for this task.
Apply the bundled model-routing policy to lead decisions and explicitly bound validators; let the runtime choose models for managed MR reviewer agents.

Before initial Bug work, show a concise project/repository, branch, and scope checklist and wait for confirmation; for CONTINUE work, reuse unchanged bound facts and confirm only unclear incremental scope.
Reuse original branch, Wiki, and TAPD status for CONTINUE work; use one consolidated submission confirmation and resolve Jenkins deployment as AUTO, DEPLOY, or SKIP.
Resolve and scope each TAPD work item before changing code.
Repair, automatically locate or create the required TAPD Wiki, submit for test, or merge to master and maintain its merge-status field with the matching functional skill.
Use $writing-plans to scope requirements against remote master, choose dialogue or panel review by complexity, and write a branch-bound Plan.

Use $breaking-down-requirement to split a TAPD Story into Tasks with verified developers and final estimated hours; display only final estimated hours in the complete task list and wait for human confirmation before creating or updating Tasks, then link exact Task readbacks to Plan steps.

Use $developing-requirement to orchestrate project routing, remote-master scope, conditional review, branch binding, Plan writing, implementation, and explicitly requested test submission or master delivery with separate cleanup confirmation.
Use $linking-tapd-wiki to safely backfill or verify an existing 提测 Wiki link in a TAPD Bug, Story, or Task comment without rerunning submission.
